title: External Evaluators (Roster for Consultancies) — Evaluator, IOM Deployment Roster
opportunity_summary: IOM is establishing a deployment roster of evaluation consultants for decentralized evaluations. Assignments cover theory-of-change reconstruction, inception/evaluation matrices, mixed-methods data collection and analysis, participatory evaluation, OECD-DAC/ALNAP criteria, UNEG standards, reporting and validation. Expected first deployment window begins 1 November 2026; indicative deployment duration is 29 days.
fit_summary: Strong strategic fit for Tuku-Tuku's emerging research/MEL specialist bench, but this is an individual evaluator roster rather than a firm contract. Candidate-level eligibility must be tested against the available and incoming MEAL CVs.
decision_rationale: Worth pursuing through a qualified Tuku-associated MEAL specialist because roster admission can create recurring UN evaluation access and strengthen Tuku's specialist network. Do not submit Jacob or any specialist until mandatory degree and evaluation-lead experience are evidenced.
mandatory_requirements: Master's degree in Evaluation, Social Sciences, International Development, Economics, Public Policy, Public Administration, Statistics or related field
At least five years relevant professional evaluation experience
At least three evaluations conducted as sole evaluator or team leader
Evaluation experience in at least two countries
Remote evaluation and virtual data collection experience
Professional proficiency in English, French or Spanish
Register on IOM Deployment Roster and upload the Mandatory Application Form
desirable_requirements: Migration, displacement, humanitarian or international-development evaluation experience
Knowledge of UNEG standards, OECD-DAC/ALNAP, contribution analysis, outcome harvesting, process tracing and realist evaluation
Qualitative-analysis software and quantitative/statistical software capability
Ethical application of AI to evaluation
strongest_matches: Tuku-Tuku now has access to at least one MEAL CV with another expected, enabling candidate screening for evaluator-led assignments
Tuku-Tuku programme work includes monitoring/reporting, field implementation, research-adjacent enterprise diagnostics and digital data workflows
Uganda and East Africa development-programme operating context
gaps: Candidate-level Master's degree not yet verified in this run
Three sole/team-lead evaluations not yet verified
Two-country evaluation record not yet verified
UNEG/OECD-DAC and specialist evaluation-method evidence not yet verified
hard_blockers: Do not apply a candidate who cannot evidence the Master's + 5 years + 3 lead evaluations + 2-country experience thresholds
deliverables: Sampling strategy and data collection instruments
application_requirements: Mandatory Application Form uploaded under Supporting Documents
Application to the specific Evaluator roster opportunity
strategic_reasons: Creates access to recurring IOM decentralized evaluation assignments
Builds Tuku-Tuku's external evaluator bench and UN-system positioning
Highly relevant to the research/MEL capability currently being assembled
winning_strategy: Screen both MEAL CVs against every mandatory criterion, nominate only a fully compliant evaluator, foreground three strongest led evaluations, two-country experience, theory-based mixed methods, OECD-DAC/UNEG practice, remote evaluation and humanitarian/development context. Treat this as specialist-network positioning rather than a Tuku corporate prime bid.
arrangement: Deployment roster; duty station to be announced
source_context: Fresh cross-source discovery. Detailed vacancy text reproduced by current tender/consultancy aggregators and linked to IOM Deployment Roster/ReliefWeb. Original IOM source was not directly retrievable in this run, therefore assessment is Partial rather than Verified.
next_action: Retrieve the IOM/ReliefWeb original vacancy and Mandatory Application Form; screen the available and incoming MEAL CVs against all mandatory thresholds; if one qualifies, complete roster profile and application before 30 September.

alert.message: New 4/5 IOM External Evaluators roster closes 30 Sep. Screen MEAL CVs against Master's + 5 years + 3 lead evaluations + 2-country threshold. JakeOS canonical upsert pending.
